title: War Historian, Repy
description:
An academic is trapped in a [purple]hanging cage[/purple] next to a [gold]treasure chest[/gold].

The academic is muttering about [sine][orange]"One-Time-Use Keys"[/orange][/sine] while furiously writing something.

Looks like you can unlock the [purple]cage[/purple] or the [gold]chest[/gold].

options.title: Unlock the Chest
options.description: Lose [gold]Lantern Key[/gold]. Procure [blue]2[/blue] random [gold]Potions[/gold]. Obtain [blue]2[/blue] random [gold]Relics[/gold].

conditions: DISABLED — IsAllowed() returns false; this event never appears in the game
notes:
[red]This event is currently disabled in the game.[/red]

Normally, the event would function as follows: You must have a [gold]Lantern Key[/gold] card in your deck to make a choice. If you're playing single-player with [gold]2+ Lantern Keys[/gold], you get a second choice after your initial decision — you can then choose the option you didn't pick first. Each choice consumes one [gold]Lantern Key[/gold]. In multiplayer, all [gold]Lantern Keys[/gold] are consumed by your first choice and the event ends.
